stations.title: Rope store
stations.text: Every rope's length on a list, in no order.

stations.title: Your functions
stations.gap: Done by hand, one by one

captions: Thursday kit night, and Dougie needs ropes long enough for a lower on the crag.
Today he checks every rope by hand and writes the answer down in pencil.
You go through each list with for, and build new lists from the old ones.
Now the ropes, the bags and the readings each come back in one call.
for over a list, enumerate, sum, min, max, sorted, and comprehensions.
